game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay, a hidden smugglers' bay: the dock cartographer must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Elif Ladder: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each.
theme: Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay: a hidden smugglers' bay
core_gameplay_loop: In Smugglers' Bay, repeat each round: Rank threats with an if/elif/else ladder and send the right response to each. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the threat_level value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Reach the cargo hold using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The cargo hold reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the cargo hold is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 9 (extended tier): Elif Ladder
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Elif Ladder' (Week 3 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Smugglers' Bay'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how threat_level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Smugglers' Bay.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The cargo hold reached with actions_used <= 22.
